Name: Harvest Valley Animals
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Remember bubble cows? Ever want them in Stardew Valley? Of course you do!

This mod adds a few Harvest Moon-inspired animals to your game:


[b][u]Barn Animals
[/u][/b]
White Bubble Cows - produce normal milks (art by me)
Coffee Bubble Cows - produce coffee milk (art by me)
Fruit Bubble Cows - produce fruit milk (art by me)
Strawberry Bubble Cows - produce strawberry milk (art by me)

You can use these flavored milks to make milkshakes in your kitchen!

Also included:

Bubble Sheep - produce wool (art by IdentityPollution)


[u][b]Coop Animals[/b][/u]

Bubble Rabbits - produce wool and rabbit feet (art by IdentityPollution)

White Bubble Chickens - produce white eggs (art by vikich3rry)
Brown Bubble Chickens - produce brown eggs (art by vikich3rry)
Gold Bubble Chickens - produce gold eggs (art by vikich3rry)
Blue Bubble Chickens - produce blue eggs (art by vikich3rry)
Galaxy Bubble Chickens - produce galaxy eggs (art by vikich3rry)

All eggs can be hatched and turned into mayo!

Future plans: maybe expand into llamas, alpacas, ducks, etc

Enjoy!
